tokens.name: vellum
tokens.usage: The ground: page background and the chart itself. Everything sits on paper.

tokens.name: vellum-deep
tokens.usage: Raised paper: panels, event cards, the port ledger. Never for text.

tokens.name: fog
tokens.usage: Uncharted sea and land. Always paired with the fog hatch pattern in ink-faint; never flat on its own.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Iron-gall ink: body text, coastlines, icons, control borders, primary button fill. Text on vellum and vellum-deep.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, captions, inactive tabs. Passes 4.5:1 on vellum in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Decorative only: hairline rules, rhumb lines, fog hatching, waterlining. Below 3:1, so never text, control borders or focus rings.

tokens.name: sea
tokens.usage: Wash for charted open water. Fill only.

tokens.name: land
tokens.usage: Ochre wash for charted land. Fill only; coastline edge is always ink.

tokens.name: vermilion
tokens.usage: Red ink: hazards (rocks, reefs), the point of no return, destructive or risky actions, warnings. Text-safe on vellum and vellum-deep.

tokens.name: verdigris
tokens.usage: Green ink: known safe routes, completed contracts, confirmations. Text-safe on vellum and vellum-deep.

tokens.name: gilt
tokens.usage: Gold leaf: resource sites, treasure, kept secrets. Fills and marks only, never text (use gilt-ink).

tokens.name: gilt-ink
tokens.usage: Money and value as text: prices, cargo worth, debt figures. Text-safe on vellum and vellum-deep.

families.display: "IM Fell English", "Iowan Old Style", Georgia, serif

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Game title and the voyage summary header. One per screen.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Screen and panel titles: Port, Landfall, The Admiralty.

styles.name: place-name
styles.usage: Named places on the chart, set along the coast. Player-given names use this style exactly like authored ones.

styles.name: place-name-sm
styles.usage: Minor features and zoomed-out place names.

styles.name: log
styles.sample: Day 14. Birds at dawn, heading south-west.
styles.usage: Captain's log entries and event narration.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The hold has room for 40 tons of cargo.
styles.usage: All interface prose, choice descriptions, tooltips.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Button text, field labels, stat names. Sentence case.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: Key numbers: days of provisions, hull, money. Use tabular figures (font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums).

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Point of no return in 6 days
styles.usage: Secondary detail under a figure or control, in ink-muted.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap, figure-to-caption gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gaps between related controls; chip padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel and card padding; gap between choices.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between panel sections; screen gutters.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Between major screen regions (chart and side panel).

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: The chart, map tiles, rules. Paper has square edges.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, event cards: just enough to soften a cut edge.

tokens.name: radius-seal
tokens.usage: Round marks only: resource-site discs, wax seals, the ship's position ring.

tokens.name: shadow-paper
tokens.usage: A sheet laid on the chart table: event cards and dialogs only. Nothing else floats.
